items.source: The same as ReactiveTypeDescriptor.singleOptionalValue(Class, Supplier) but for a non-deferred, async type such as CompletableFuture.
items.translation: 与ReactiveTypeDescriptor.singleOptionalValue(Class, Supplier)相同，但适用于非延迟的异步类型，例如CompletableFuture。

items.source: Register a reactive type along with functions to adapt to and from a Reactive Streams Publisher.
items.translation: 注册一个反应式类型，并附带用于适配和从 Reactive Streams Publisher 转换的函数。

items.source: Uses of ReactiveTypeDescriptor in org.springframework.core
Descriptor for a reactive type that can produce 0..N values.
items.translation: 用于生成0..N个值的反应式类型的描述符。

items.source:
Provides basic classes for exception handling and version detection,
and other core helpers that are not specific to any part of the framework.
items.translation: 提供用于异常处理和版本检测的基础类，以及其他不针对框架任何特定部分的辅助核心工具。

items.source: Return the descriptor of the reactive type for the adapter.
items.translation: 返回适配器对应的反应式类型的描述符。

items.source: Descriptor for a reactive type that does not produce any values.
items.translation: 用于描述不产生任何值的反应式类型的描述符。

items.source: Descriptor for a reactive type that can produce 0..1 values.
items.translation: 用于生成 0..1 个值的反应式类型的描述符。

items.source: Descriptor for a reactive type that must produce 1 value to complete.
items.translation: 用于必须产生 1 个值以完成完成的反应式类型的描述符。

items.source:
Constructor for an adapter with functions to convert the target reactive
or async type to and from a Reactive Streams Publisher.
items.translation: 用于将目标响应式或异步类型转换为响应式流 Publisher 并从其转换的适配器构造函数。
